**What we’re building**  
A small “Reviews & Ratings” section where logged‑in customers can give 1‑5 stars and write a text review for each product. The data is private to the reviewer; nobody else can edit or delete someone else’s rating.

**Risk level**: **Amber**  
- We’re storing personal data (review text, star score, user ID, product ID).  
- Users will log in so we can tie a review to them.  
- No money flows, so we don’t need payments or billing.

**Safety parts that we will add**  
| Feature | Safe‑defaults we’ll build in |
|---------|------------------------------|
| **Logins with email only** | We’ll use Supabase Auth magic‑link (no password). |
| **Database rules** | Row‑level security so each user can only see and edit **their** reviews. |
| **Spending cap on AI** | Not needed – we’re only storing text. |
| **Key protection** | All Supabase or other keys live in the environment (.env or Lovable Secrets), never in the browser. |
| **“Delete my review”** | Confirm dialog, server‑side delete, file cleanup (not needed for text). |
| **Read‑rights** | Users can only read their own reviews or public product pages (no data leakage). |

---

## 1‑Screen Plan

```
What we are building: A product review feature.  
Who uses it: Logged‑in customers.  
Risk level: Amber (privacy + login).  
Day‑one features: 1. Star rating & text review form. 2. List of a product’s reviews. 3. Edit/delete own review.  
Information it stores: reviews (star, text, user_id, product_id) – private.  
Logins: email‑only magic link.  
Money: none.  
Built with: Supabase (Auth & Postgres) + Lovable front‑end.  
Steps: 1. Add Supabase Auth and a login page. 2. Create a reviews table + RLS. 3. Add UI for posting, listing, editing, deleting.  
Safety: keys secret, data locked to owner, RLS enforced, save point before each step.  
Not in v1: guest reviews, ratings without login, payment integration.  
```
